items.ti: 이 완전하고 총체적인 패자 Bill Maher에 대해 이야기합시다. 그는 똑같이 낮은 등급의 HBO에서 낮은 등급의 쇼를 진행하고 있는데, 이는 오래 전에 품질과 흥분의 네트워크였던 것입니다. 그러나 그것은 모두 사라졌습니다. 더 이상 '핫'하지 않아요! Maher의 친구이자 사업 동료인 Chuck LaBella도 내 친구였으며 The Top Hit Show, The Apprentice에서 "gofer"로 일했으며, 그 쇼의 성공으로 인해 여러 주 동안 1위와 최고 등급을 받았으며 Finale'가 올해의 최고 쇼 중 하나가 되면서 그는 역사적인 "해프닝"과 관련된 다른 모든 사람들과 함께 NBC 순위에 자동으로 빠르게 올라갔습니다. 견습생의 성공은 너무 커서 모두가 참여할 만큼 훌륭했습니다. 많은 경력을 쌓았으니 정말 멋진 일입니다. 어떤 사람들은 내가 대통령이 되었기 때문에 그것이 내 경력을 쌓았다고 말합니다(그것이 없었다면 나는 승리했을 것입니다!). 어쨌든 지난 몇 년간 LaBel은
items.ti_en: Let’s talk about this COMPLETE AND TOTAL LOSER, Bill Maher. He’s got a Low Rated Show on equally Low Rated HBO, which was once, long ago, a Network of Quality and Excitement — But that’s all gone. It’s not “HOT” anymore! Maher’s friend and business associate, Chuck LaBella, was also a friend of mine, worked on The Top Hit Show, The Apprentice, as a “gofer” and, because of the success of that show, Number One and Top Rated on many weeks, with the Finale’ being among the Top Shows of the Year, he was automatically and quickly brought up through the Ranks of NBC, along with everyone else associated with that Historic “Happening.” The Success of the Apprentice was so great that everyone partook — It built many careers, and that is a wonderful thing. Some people say it even built my career, because I became President (I would have won without it!). In any event, over the last few years, LaBella would call me nonstop to say, “Hello,” be very nice, and tell me how much Bill Maher “loves” and respects me, and would constantly ask of me, even before I was President, for any form of meeting with Maher and, would I do his show? When I became President, I agreed to meet, after the first one, and the last one, but never agreed to do his show, which he wants me to do, DESPARATELY — It won’t happen! When I have watched the show, which isn’t often, it always ends with dishonesty, about me at least, but, who cares? He doesn’t think it was a good thing to take the Nuclear Weapon away from Iran, which shows you that he is not very smart. If I allowed them to obtain a Nuclear Weapon, the World would be a different place right now! Using Fake Polls, he also said I had my Lowest Ratings so far, “and even the Republican Party doesn’t like him,” but that’s not true. I have High Ratings and, more importantly, he said that I’m losing the support and approval of the Republican Party when, in fact, CNN just came out with a Poll showing that I’m at 98 and 99% support within the Republican Party, an All Time Record High. Ronald Reagan was at 86%. CNN’s Harry Enten also said I am “The Most Influential President of the Last Century.” CNN did another Poll at who was the Most Popular Person in the History of the Republican Party, and I won that, too, with me being at 53%, Ronald Reagan being at 18%, and Abraham Lincoln being at 8%, and these are CNN Polls, people not exactly in love with me, so, Bill Maher lied, but he lies about everything, and I believe he lied to me when I asked him, with all the applause and laughter he gets after almost everything he says, about thing that aren’t funny or even any good, what Laughter Machine does he use? People can’t think he’s funny. I didn’t know Bill, he didn’t know me, and that was OK. Then Chuck LaBella, and my friend, Kid Rock, called me incessantly about meeting with Bill Maher. My first response was, “Fellas, this guy’s a Goofball.” They said, “He wants to go down to the White House, be with you, and talk. He said you’re very smart, but you’re not into the Liberal Platform. Will you start thinking about it?” He invited himself to the White House! We had our first meeting, Bill was very nervous. He asked for a drink. He was very insecure, and he had a seriously bruised eye and nose area, as though somebody had just beaten him up — But it wasn’t me! No sooner had we had that first dinner at the White House, which is a very seductive and beautiful place, especially now that I have fully renovated and fixed it in the style which it deserves, Bill wanted to come back. The Gofer called me multiple times, saying how much Bill loves me, that he respects me more than anybody, and wants to come back for a second meeting. After ten calls from Chuck LaBella, it seemed that these guys were serious, and wanted to learn more, because their Policies are so bad, it’s ridiculous! Also, I wanted to tell Bill that he’s a major POTHEAD. He’s got to stop, it’s very bad for his health. He looked like hell this time. Bill was drunk and had alcohol in his hand as he walked through the White House. Stephen A. Smith and Kid Rock came along with him. Overall, I thought it was a good meeting. It didn’t last four hours, it lasted two hours, maybe less, and everybody was happy. We have the timestamps. I learned nothing, and felt it was a waste of time. After the first dinner, Bill Maher was friendly, I guess, everyone walked away pleased. He gave me a good first show, with lots of Laughing Machine laughter, which is a real term, but it is what it is, and then reverted back to his former self, and his old ways. I understand that. He’s doing his thing. I never took it very personally. I would always mock his Low Ratings, whenever I heard. He’s not a nice guy, and what he spouts isn’t what he believes. He has to cater to his base, which is mostly composed of Losers, and people who don’t like working. It’s why, for so long, I didn’t get another call from Chuck LaBella, and I didn’t miss him one bit. After the second dinner, Bill’s “show” was far worse than the first. He went crazy! He’s gutless, because he enjoyed every minute. Also, I am not a building a swimming pool in the White House Briefing Room, and never had any intention of doing so. I am thinking about moving the Press, and putting them in a different location, but I will use that location for very badly needed space. Bill also attacked our Great Republican Candidates, when he knows my Endorsement Record is 98% in the House, and 100% in the Senate, so how can he make a false statement like this? These Statistics are FACTS, and he should speak about them, but he won’t, because he is very unfair! Karoline Leavitt was GREAT on the show, but she started with a biased, dumb SLEAZEBAG, asking questions. She defended me, and herself, so well, but couldn’t be comfortable going against Lie after Lie. Importantly, Bill lied about all of the Illegal Voters in the Radical controlled, decrepit, and devastated State of California. Just in the last few days alone, they found 20,000, and the number could easily go to over 1,000,000. There were so many other falsehoods Bill spewed, but I won’t waste time in FACT CHECKING him. He isn’t worth it. Bill: Don’t call anymore. It’s useless, and tell Chuck LaBella not to call so much, and say how much you love “TRUMP,” and want to get together, because you’re a hopeless guy, who is just trying to cater to your small group of “fans.” You’re also a coward who is afraid to tell the truth about how well our Country is running because of your few “fans,” and how badly the Dumocrats have done, almost destroying the U.S.A. If I hadn’t won the Election, it would be DEAD! Also, turn your Laugh Machine off, it’s a joke when they laugh uncontrollably, even when you say nothing funny, and I’m going to have the Republicans not cover you anymore, because they try to talk about you as a guy who is transformative. You’re not transformative, you’re a Loser! I never watched your show much, but I will never watch it again, because it is nothing more than FAKE NEWS that America, and the World, is unfortunately subjected to. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 저는 미국의 최신 플래그십 국립공원인 애리조나의 치리카후아 국립공원을 발표하게 된 것을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다! 첫 번째 임기 동안 저는 역사상 최대 규모의 국립공원 투자 중 하나인 GREAT American Outdoors Act에 서명하고 웨스트버지니아 주에 새로운 국립공원을 지정했습니다. 즉, 이제 모든 미국인에게 63번째와 64번째 국립공원을 부여했습니다. 다른 어떤 대통령도 미국과 제가 사랑하고 크게 승리한 주인 애리조나를 위해 이 일을 해낼 수 없었습니다! 이 법안을 의회에서 통과시키는 큰 승리를 거둔 위대한 공화당 하원의원이자 미국 최초의 애국자인 Juan Ciscomani에게 축하를 보냅니다. Andy Biggs, David Schweikert, Eli Crane, Abe Hamadeh 및 Paul Gosar를 포함한 뉴욕주의 다른 모든 위대한 하원의원들에게 축하를 전합니다. 우리는 공원과 애리조나를 다시 훌륭하게 만들고 있습니다! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
items.ti_en: I am proud to announce the NEWEST FLAGSHIP NATIONAL PARK in the Country, CHIRICAHUA NATIONAL PARK in ARIZONA! In my First Term, I signed the GREAT American Outdoors Act, one of the LARGEST Investments in National Parks in HISTORY, and designated a new National Park in the Great State of West Virginia, meaning, I’ve now given ALL Americans their 63rd and 64th National Park. No other President was able to get this done for America, and Arizona, a State I love and won BIG! Congratulations to GREAT Republican Congressman and America First Patriot Juan Ciscomani for his MAJOR WIN passing this Bill through Congress. Congratulations to all of our other Great Congressmen in the State, including Andy Biggs, David Schweikert, Eli Crane, Abe Hamadeh, and Paul Gosar. We are MAKING OUR PARKS, AND ARIZONA, GREAT AGAIN! President DONALD J. TRUMP
